title: Split Add Availability start-time into hour/minute/AM-PM dropdowns and move theme toggle into header

requirements.text: Replace the existing single “Start Time” selector on the Add Availability UI (the Add Availability modal/page where a user selects a start time) with three dropdowns: Hour, Minute, and AM/PM, and use these inputs to produce the same stored `time` string format currently used by availability (e.g., "8:00 AM").

quotes: 1) on the add availability modal where a user is selecting a start time

acceptanceCriteria: The start time control in `frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.tsx` no longer uses the single Select bound directly to `time`.
The UI shows three dropdowns labeled Hour, Minute, and AM/PM for selecting a start time.
Selecting values in the three dropdowns updates the availability `time` value used on submit to match the existing string style (e.g., "10:00 AM").
When editing an existing availability, the existing `time` value pre-populates the three dropdowns correctly for all values previously offered in the time list (8:00 AM through 9:00 PM).
If the existing saved `time` value is not parseable into Hour/Minute/AM-PM, the UI still displays a safe fallback state and does not crash; the user can select a new time and save successfully.
User-facing text remains in English (e.g., labels and placeholders).

requirements.text: Move the light/dark mode toggle out of the profile dropdown and into a dedicated header button positioned immediately to the left of the profile icon/menu in the top bar.

quotes: 3)put button to the left of profile icon

acceptanceCriteria: In `frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.tsx`, the theme toggle is no longer rendered as a `DropdownMenuItem` inside the profile dropdown.
A standalone button (icon or text) appears in the header to the left of the profile dropdown trigger when the user is logged in.
Clicking the new header theme button calls the existing theme toggle behavior (switching between light and dark) and continues to persist via `localStorage` as before.
The profile dropdown still includes Logout and continues to function as before.

constraints: Do not edit any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (read-only UI component sources must be composed, not edited).
Do not edit the immutable hook files: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, or `frontend/src/main.tsx`.
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor; no backend changes are required for this request.
nonGoals: Do not change availability backend storage format or add new availability fields in Motoko.
Do not add new authentication providers (Internet Identity remains the only auth).
Do not add new pages or routes unrelated to Add Availability or the header theme toggle.
